Name: HD Portrait For AB's Lance
Author: yiyinzhi
Description:
I really love the Lance Elf (ID  33539) and another portrait by the same creator (ID 39063), especially their Western Fantasy Knight uniform style. Because I like them so much, I spent about a month working on and off to create this HD portrait. It's finally done today!

[b]Installation[/b]

1，please download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33539]Lance Sprite Rework[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url].

2，Download and unzip the folder, then drag png to Mods > Portraiture > Portraits.

3，Enter the game, press P to switch the portrait when talking to Lance, then press O to lock it.

ps: Since the original creator has deleted their account, if he happen to see this mod and have any issues with it, please contact me and I will take it down.
